subject: Re: Cutover control map & weekend migration windows
messages:
From: Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@stratus-retail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratus-retail.com>
Date: 2025-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cutover windows & initial MAP ask

Soojin — thanks for taking this on. As we prepare for our next-phase rollout of Redwood for Stratus, we want to lock a mutually agreeable cutover plan and a short MAP that lists milestones, owners, and blackout windows. High level context: we have a POS holiday test the weekend of 2025-06-21 and we need the Redwood integration finalized before then (ideally week of 6/16) to run cert tests.

Proposed constraints:
- Preferred cutover weekend: 2025-06-20 to 2025-06-22 (US Pacific)
- Preferred maintenance window: Sat 02:00–06:00 PT (low traffic)
- Acceptance criteria: 4 successful payment flows + end-to-end inventory sync validated by Inventory Ops

Can your team share a short MAP and confirm whether the above weekend works. Also let us know if you anticipate any gating security evidence (we may need SOC2 logs by 6/12).

Thanks — I can be flexible on times later this week if we need a quick alignment call.

—Paul
Director of Integrations
Stratus Retail
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@stratus-retail.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratus-retail.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cutover windows & initial MAP ask

Paul — appreciate the clear constraints. I pulled together a compact MAP and a weekend cutover plan (attached: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) that maps milestones to owners and lists contingency checkpoints. Summary below; attachment has a simple three-week timeline and owner matrix.

Key milestones (short form):
1) Staging smoke validation — owner: ben_carter — target complete by 2025-06-12
2) Security evidence handoff (SOC2 logs snapshot) — owner: monica_patel — provide by 2025-06-12
3) Dry run (end-to-end test) — owner: paul.jensen (Stratus)/ben_carter — scheduled 2025-06-16
4) Cutover weekend — owner: marissa_cole (CS lead) & ben_carter (ops) — 2025-06-20 to 2025-06-22; maintenance window Sat 02:00–06:00 PT
5) Post-cutover acceptance & rollback window — owner: Elena Morales (Stratus)/marissa_cole — 48h after cutover

Risks we call out in the MAP: data-volume-induced cold-start latency, 3rd-party token refresh timing, and single-region fallback if there is a GPU pool capacity issue. Contingencies are in the attachment.

Ask: please confirm the Sat 02:00–06:00 PT window and that your Ops can join the dry run on 6/16. If confirmed, we’ll lock DocuSign for the cutover addendum and share a staging runbook PDF.

Attaching: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx

thanks,
Soojin
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@stratus-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-05T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cutover windows & initial MAP ask

Adding ops notes on the staging smoke and dry run:

- Staging smoke checklist (high level):
  * Model endpoint reachable (healthcheck /v1/health)
  * KV cache primed for representative sessions
  * Token refresh path validated with Stratus auth proxy
  * End-to-end payment flow stubbed with test cards (we will provide a payoff script)

- Capacity: we will pin a dedicated GPU pool for your dry run to avoid noisy neighbors; allocation request needs 48h lead.
- Rollback plan: snapshot DB + rollback playbook so we can revert within 30 minutes if API stability degrades.

I’ll prepare the runbook-staging.pdf and a one-page ops play (will attach to the shared Drive). Ben (ops) will be on call during the 02:00–06:00 window.

—Ben
Staff Engineer, Runtime & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@stratus-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-05T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cutover windows & initial MAP ask

Paul/Sojourn team — quick note from CS regarding acceptance gates and the handoff cadence:

- Acceptance gates (must pass prior to go/no-go):
  1) Latency SLO check: 95th percentile < 350ms for read-only endpoints during smoke
  2) Transaction accuracy: 4/4 payment flows & inventory sync validated by Inventory Ops
  3) Error budget: no more than 2% total errors in staging dry run

- Handoff cadence:
  * Pre-cutover sync (6/16 dry run): 60-min call with ops, product, and Stratus QA
  * Cutover command center: 6/20 01:30 PT standup, on-call roster attached in the Drive
  * Post-cutover wrap: 6/22 10:00 PT retrospective (30 min)

I’ll own the cutover command center and post-cutover acceptance. I included Monica on SOC evidence thread — Monica, can you confirm we can provide a logs snapshot by 6/12 (minimal redaction)?

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@stratus-retail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@stratus-retail.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-06T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cutover windows & initial MAP ask

Thanks, team — the windows look reasonable. A few items from our side:

- Confirmed: dry run on 6/16, cutover weekend 6/20–6/22, maintenance window Sat 02:00–06:00 PT.
- SOC2 logs: we need a time-bounded snapshot for 6/01–6/04 for our security review; if you can provide by 6/12 that’s great.
- Can you add a short list of rollback triggers in the MAP (high error rate, payment gateway timeouts, inventory divergence > 0.5%)?

One more ask: because our POS test touches live test cards, we’d like to have a short statement in the runbook that no customer PII will be retained beyond the test scope. If you can add that line in runbook-staging.pdf that would satisfy our compliance.

We’ll lock the dates internally and expect a DocuSign addendum for the cutover fee.

—Elena
VP, Platform Integrations
Stratus Retail
